content.comment_body: Hello, I have connected an Exor HMI panel to a [product_name] controller [version_no]. How can I ensure that values from digital and analog network input functions (e.g., voltage measurement) remain saved even after the controller restarts?
Hello [user_name], please avoid submitting multiple posts about the same issue. You have also posted here: [url]

This thread is closed due to duplicate posting. The second post regarding persistent memory values for network input functions has been published in the software conference section for [product_name]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user has difficulty maintaining persistent values from digital and analog network input functions following a restart of the [product_name] controller. This highlights a challenge in retaining memory and ensuring value persistence when integrating an HMI with the controller, particularly after a system reboot.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that digital and analog network input function values will be saved persistently in the [product_name] controller, so that these values are retained after a restart and the system can resume operations with the same parameters as before the shutdown.
pain_keywords: no persistent memory for network input values
